fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.anglerfish.d: An aggressive fish that thrives in dark waters. They are fast and they are vicious. Do not fall prey to the light.
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.captain_corn: Long ago, she tried to find the secrets hidden deep within the ice. It was only when the piecing eyes of a god stared back at her, that she realized her hubris. Rest her soul.
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.eel.descript: A powerful oceanic creature, guarding the graveyards of old naval journeys. They cannot be moved, and siphon life from all they strike.
A glittering moth that prefers cold climates. Somehow, it seems to be made of pure gold.
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.maw.descript: Aggressive fish that have adapted to the cold nights of fjords. Watch your step, for they will devour whatever they can latch their jaws around.
A massive stingray found deep under the ice sheets. It causes intense vibrations under the ice, and makes people and ships dissapear in equal measure.
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.shellback.de: There is a shell upon his back.
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.spinefish.de: Fish adapted for icy waters. Eating them isn't the best idea...
fieldguide.entity.aquamirae.tortured_sou: Sometimes, illagers get lost in the vast icy mazes. Beware their echoes in the dark, for they can dissapear without warning and ambush any who aren't vigilant.
